rawContent: A criminal justice system that works in defense of itself cannot be reformed to help the people it victimize. #DefundThePolice #BreonnaTaylor ##BlackLivesMatter

And then we get to listen to the Prosecutor lecture folx about “mob violence” like this country wasn’t built on anti-Black mob violence. This is such a terrible farce. Im sorry, y’all #BreonnaTaylor #BlackLivesMatter

Such a contrast between all of the #BlackLivesMatter  street murals, magazine covers, corporate and celebrity declarations and KY’s “justice” system’s decision. Just a reminder that symbolism is not enough. Goal is to defeat and dismantle police power
